description: This is a 3D model of a minimalist sofa set, including a two-seater sofa, an armchair with a large cushion, and a rectangular coffee table. The sofa has two square cushions, and the armchair is accompanied by a rounded, oversized cushion that appears to be a beanbag or large floor pillow. The furniture is rendered in a single, uniform light gray color, suggesting a modern or abstract aesthetic. The clean lines and lack of ornamentation are characteristic of a contemporary or minimalist design. The overall presentation implies a functional living room arrangement.
